channel: Wikimedia Commons - early public-tool era 2022-2024 (Stable Diffusion frame-by-frame / Deforum-style animation, ModelScope, AnimateDiff, Runway Gen-1/2/3/4, Pika, Luma Dream Machine/Ray, Midjourney video, Haiper, Kaiber, Genmo, Pixverse, Stable Video Diffusion, CogVideoX). Method: Commons API category enumeration (all AI-video categories and by-year/by-model categories), ~60 file-namespace full-text searches, per-file wikitext + extmetadata + Structured Data read, uploader contribution lists; developer primary sources (Runway, Stability AI, Luma via Wayback, CogVideo GitHub/arXiv, Hugging Face) for model/date corroboration; Wayback captures of the YouTube watch pages behind the video2commons uploads to check the YouTube licence flag independently; ffprobe/scene-cut/frame-difference/corner-static heuristics in the Higgsfield sandbox. No frame was ever viewed by me; all content statements come from Commons page text, ffprobe and pixel statistics. Commons holds very few genuine 2022-2024 AI-video files: there is NO file for Pika, Luma Ray, Runway Gen-4, Kaiber, Deforum, AnimateDiff, ModelScope (other than the Will Smith spaghetti clip), Zeroscope, Haiper, Genmo, Pixverse or Midjourney video.

integrity_checks.note: commons_sha1 = SHA-1 registered on Commons (imageinfo). downloaded_matches_sha1=true means I downloaded the exact media_url in the sandbox and the SHA-1 matched; false/absent = not downloaded in full (large files were only HEAD-checked and probed; 480p transcodes were used for scene analysis).

candidates.description: Page text: 10-second, 300-frame animation of a young woman in a park, 30 fps, one txt2img frame upscaled to 1024x1024 then 300 img2img passes (denoise 0.4). Keyframes: 'park background' at 0-2 s, 'ocean view background, hair blowing in wind' at 4-6 s, 'ocean view background, smirk' at 8-10 s.
candidates.prompt: txt2img: 'portrait of young woman, medium shot, ((beautiful face)), high detail, collarbones, art by greg rutkowski and Alphonse Mucha, park background, bright lighting, facing camera'. Negative: 'out of frame, extra fingers, mutated hands, ((poorly drawn hands)), ((poorly drawn face)), (((mutation))), (((deformed))), ((ugly)), blurry, ((bad anatomy)), (((bad proportions))), ((extra limbs)), extra face, ((pubic hair)), nipples, hat'. Steps 50, Euler a, CFG 8, 512x512 then SD upscale; animation: denoise 0.4, 30 fps, 10 s.
candidates.watermark_notes: None expected (locally rendered frames, no service overlay). Pixel heuristic on the 480p transcode (temporal std + static-edge test in all four corners) found no static overlay. Not visually verified.

excerpt_suggestions.why: Opening keyframes; highest per-second frame-to-frame change in the clip (mean abs luma diff about 7.3/255 in second 1, falling to about 5/255) - every frame is a fresh diffusion pass, so texture churn should be visible. Unviewed.
Prompt switches to 'ocean view background, hair blowing in wind' at 4 s - expect background and face drift while the subject prompt stays the same. Unviewed; judge by eye.

candidates.notes: Sibling of the flowers clip (same author/method; H1 lists the flowers clip as sd14_flowers_img2img_animation_2022). ShareAlike: CC BY-SA applies to adaptations (crops/edits) of this clip; keep credit + licence link and mark changes. Commons categories 'Cleavage in AI art' / 'Cleavage of young women' - subject is a synthetic young woman in a park; review frames for suggestiveness before use. Prompt names artists (Greg Rutkowski, Alphonse Mucha) - do not show the prompt on screen without a decision on that. 104 MB, 83 Mbps VP9: make an edit proxy. Heuristic frame metrics (480p transcode): no hard cuts, luma pulses small (<0.2/255).
